FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

2. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.

3. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.

4. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

5. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.

6. When practising Reading for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Vocabulary.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Vocabulary.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Vocabulary.

7. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. livre
   B. fenêtre
   C. porte
   D. chaise

8. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

9. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good night only
   B. Good morning / hello
   C. Excuse me
   D. Thank you

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
